comparison.objective: PR-1968 installs a comb busbar across three breaker terminals; the candidate sets one gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1968 tests opening several terminals, simultaneous multi-pin insertion, and sequential screwdriver tightening; the candidate tests coaxial adjustment plus jam-nut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1968 requires all pins home, three screws clamped, pull resistance, and released tools; the candidate requires angular accuracy and repeatability after three articulated cycles.
comparison.reason: Generic screw driving is shared, but multi-terminal insertion and clamping do not test retaining an adjusted screw against locknut reaction.
